items.title: Peter Erskine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Like Mozart. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Yeah he was pretty remarkable.

ctx.x: fourth tenor and the baritone sax. He’d flesh out the chart. And, you know, he said, “I have it all up here. It’s already written I’m just getting it down on paper.”
Yeah. Yeah he was pretty remarkable.
